normalization: H denotes the decaying normalized target; the raw endpoint contribution exp(t/4) must be removed or coupled before applying telescoping
single_cone_reduction: if L_h(t) is PSD for every finite size and positive rational t,h, and H(s)->0 as s->infinity, then M_h(t) is PSD by telescoping and closure of finite PSD cones
operator_meaning: L_h(t) is the Gram/localizing form for 1-y; M_h is reconstructed as its positive tail integral/sum
divided_difference_meaning: Q_h(t) is the interval average of -M_h'(s), connecting the finite-difference source chart to the reported outer-H Stieltjes density
acceptance_test: Construct a source-derived positive Gram or J-fraction factor for Q_h(t) at every finite size and rational positive t,h, verify H tends to zero with completed tail control, and recover the Hankel cone by telescoping.
